name: app-6ab43744e9248191b6435f79ca1640d4
description: Look up customers, active jobs, estimates, invoices, and bills from your active QuickAdmin company in ChatGPT. Sign in with your QuickAdmin account to access records your permissions allow. Document summaries can include status, totals, currencies, and internal notes.

interface.longDescription: Look up customers, active jobs, estimates, invoices, and bills from your active QuickAdmin company in ChatGPT. Sign in with your QuickAdmin account to access records your permissions allow. Document summaries can include status, totals, currencies, and internal notes.
defaultPrompt: List up to five active jobs I can access.
Show my active company and up to five customers.
Show up to five invoices with status, total, and currency.

review.commerce_description: A free registered QuickAdmin account supports all plugin features. The plugin does not offer purchases or process payments.
prompts: Show up to five active jobs I can access.
Show the first two invoices and then the next two.

positive.description: Seed a matching customer and an unrelated customer.
positive.tools_triggered: quickadmin_context followed by quickadmin_customers with company_id from context and query=Demo Electric.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only matching customer summaries returned for the active company.

positive.prompt: Show up to five active jobs I can access.
positive.tools_triggered: quickadmin_context followed by quickadmin_jobs with company_id from context and limit=5.
positive.expected_behavior: Show at most five returned active jobs with access.

positive.description: Replace the placeholder with an accessible demo estimate ID.
positive.tools_triggered: quickadmin_context followed by quickadmin_estimates with company_id from context and id=demo estimate ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned status, total, and currency.

positive.description: Seed at least four accessible invoices.
positive.prompt: Show the first two invoices and then the next two.
positive.tools_triggered: quickadmin_context followed by quickadmin_invoices with company_id from context and limit=2, offset=0, then limit=2 and offset=returned next_offset.
positive.expected_behavior: Show both pages using returned records.

positive.tools_triggered: quickadmin_context followed by quickadmin_bills with company_id from context and query=Demo Supplies.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize matching returned bills, including totals and currencies.

negative.description: Explain that QuickAdmin MCP cannot perform the requested action. Do not invoke a tool to perform it or claim it succeeded.
